data.title: Design, Supply, Installation and Civil Works for a City-Wide Safe-City CCTV Surveillance Network and Command & Control Centre
data.summary: Sealed bids are invited for the design, supply, installation and associated civil works for a city-wide safe-city CCTV surveillance network in Islamabad. The scope includes approximately 1,200 cameras, pole foundations, underground fibre ducting, a redundant fibre backbone, and a central command & control centre with video wall and analytics, to be completed within 18 months.

qa_items.question: Submit a detailed methodology covering camera deployment, civil works, fibre ducting and command-centre integration.
Provide a CPM-based work programme demonstrating completion within 18 months, including civil-works contingencies.
Propose key staff including a Project Manager (PEC-registered professional engineer, 15+ years), a Civil Works Lead and a Network/Security Lead.
Propose a video-analytics platform with face and licence-plate recognition and a redundant storage architecture.
Describe the HSE management system for civil works on live public roads, including a traffic-management plan.

data.submission_instructions: Bids shall be submitted under Single Stage – Two Envelope procedure (PPRA Rules 2014) in two separate sealed envelopes to the Director (Procurement), Capital Development Authority, Islamabad.
